faq.q: What is Only Raw Records in GTA 6?
faq.a: Only Raw Records is a fictional hip-hop record label and recording studio co-founded by characters Dre'Quan Priest and Boobie Ike. Dre'Quan runs its creative side while Boobie funds it.

faq.q: Who funds Only Raw Records in GTA 6?
faq.a: Boobie Ike, the owner of the Jack of Hearts strip club, provides the funding, according to Rockstar's official character bios for the two founders.

faq.q: Who is signed to Only Raw Records?
faq.a: The label's first signing is the rap duo Real Dimez, made up of performers Bae-Luxe and Roxy, according to the record's key facts.

faq.q: Is Only Raw Records a real record label?
faq.a: No. It is fictional, created for Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar's official character material for Dre'Quan Priest and Boobie Ike corroborates its existence within the story.

faq.q: Where is Only Raw Records located in GTA 6?
faq.a: The record does not give a physical location for the label or studio. It only describes the label's ownership structure and its first signed act.

faq.q: How big a role does Only Raw Records play in the GTA 6 story?
faq.a: The record describes it as central to Dre'Quan Priest's character arc, but the extent of its involvement in missions or the wider plot has not been detailed by Rockstar.
